baseline.note: Historical thirteen-node pre-retune snapshot only; it keeps its original supply numbers and is never a current-run target.

policies.name: novice-no-refresh-level7
policies.description: Use only the free shops; delay level7 until the finale and favour pairs. No paid refresh or commission.

policies.name: novice-few-refresh-level7
policies.description: One paid refresh at stages5/7/9/12; commission the first seeded one- or two-cost gift at its real cost+2 while pursuing pairs.

policies.name: population-operation-level8
policies.description: Population growth capped at level8; paid refresh and card budgets are candidate spending ceilings, not guaranteed shop acquisitions.

policies.name: late-level10-real-recruitment
policies.description: Production finite-shop transactions with paid recruitment and refreshes; reach level10 in final preparation after natural rewards from previous victories. Does not assert combat victories.
